newsitem.title: UK: Fergie puts on brave face at TV awards ceremony.
newsitem.headline: Fergie puts on brave face at TV awards ceremony.

text.p: Britain's Duchess of York put on a brave face on Tuesday at a television awards ceremony and joked about the controversy surrounding the publication of intimate details of her private life.
In a surprise appearance at the National Television Awards in London the ex-wife of Queen Elizabeth's second son, Prince Andrew, read out the nominations for the best drama award.
"I am sure that some of you may think I should be receiving this award rather than presenting it," she told the audience.

It was one of her first public appearances in Britain since Madame Vasso Kortesis, a Greek mystic she had consulted, published sensational allegations about the flame-haired duchess's relationships with several men.

The lurid revelations about the sex life of the former Sarah Ferguson, now known as Fergie, and reports that her bank overdraft had skyrocketed to five million pounds ($7.8 million), led to newspapers reports that Queen Elizabeth had decided on a pay-off for the duchess in exchange for making her give up custody of her two young daughters.
A spokeswoman for the duchess called the reports "ludicrous" and "absolute fabrication".
"The Duchess is very hurt and upset by these stories, as any mother would be. She is completely devoted to her children," the spokeswoman said.
